note: status.yml as StatusDatabase loads it, by SC_ value. icon is the EFST_ value, -1 for EFST_BLANK. states, calc_flags and flags are the SCS_, SCB_ and SCF_ names without their prefix; calc_flags is [All] for SCB_ALL, which loadingFinished also sets for a status with a script. opt1 is the OPT1_ value; opt2, opt3 and options are OPT2_, OPT3_ and OPTION_ bits. fail, end_on_start, end_return and end_on_end are SC_ values in file order. duration_skill is the DurationLookup skill, and durations and durations2 its Duration1 and Duration2 for levels 1 to 13 as SkillDatabase::parseNode fills them. script is the status script, as it appears in the file.
